lab.name: Forkweb.linux
lab.deployment: GitHub Pages static frontend with upstream emulator assets

runtime.network: optional public WebSocket relay; relay may be unavailable or shared

limitations.apt: Not guaranteed; available commands depend on the selected guest distribution
limitations.dockerDaemon: Not included by default; this browser emulator does not provide a host Docker daemon
limitations.persistence: Use emulator save/load state when supported; do not assume server-side home persistence
limitations.commandExecution: Commands run inside the emulated guest, not on the website host

note: This manifest describes the current browser-emulation implementation. It does not claim to provide a full Ubuntu server, Docker host, or every command listed in the earlier real-terminal target manifest.
